cohort: 31 pregnancies (13 women treated with TFL and 18 partners of TFL-treated men)
finding: Pregnancy outcomes in women treated with teriflunomide and partners of men treated with teriflunomide were consistent with those of the general population.
mod_finding: Of the 18 partners of TFL-treated men, there were 14 normal deliveries, 2 induced deliveries, and 2 cesarean sections.
